autoOff_tooltip: Change back to the previous state automatically after the given interval. 0 switches it off.
help_ibutton: Sliding switch in the style of the Giva Labs iButton; the handle can be dragged.
help_rocker: Rocker switch with two keys; the pressed key stands for the current state. "Light style" shows the bright variant.
help_slider_dark: Dark slider with OFF and ON; the label of the current state lights up.
help_slider_dark_off_on: Dark slider with the "on" label on the right half.
help_slider_dark_on_off: Dark slider with the "on" label on the left half.
help_switch_light: Light switch with OFF and ON. Clicking a half switches to that state.
help_toggleswitch: Two labels with a small slider between them. It follows the theme of vis-2.
label_tooltip: The label used to be part of the image, now it can be changed. Leave empty for no text.
resizeContainer_tooltip: "false" makes the switch as wide as the widget, otherwise it sizes itself from the labels.
resizeHandle_tooltip: "auto" resizes the handle only when the labels differ from ON/OFF.
test_tooltip: Shows the switch in the "on" position while the editor is open.
width_tooltip: Width of the track between the two labels, in pixels.
